mechanism: Echinacea may have mild immunostimulatory effects and potential hepatic metabolism interactions via CYP3A4, while irbesartan is metabolized primarily by CYP2C9, resulting in minimal direct pharmacokinetic conflict.
action: No dose adjustment required; monitor blood pressure control; advise patient to use echinacea for short-term immune support only (typically ≤10 days) rather than chronic use.
